title: Liza Soberano, H.E.R’s ‘BRB’ earns two Hollywood Music in Media Awards nominations
summary: “BRB,” a song performed by Liza Soberano and Grammy-winning artist H.E.R. for DreamWorks Animation’s “Forgotten Island,” has received two nominations at the 2026 Hollywood Music in Media Awards…

blocks.text: “BRB,” a song performed by Liza Soberano and Grammy-winning artist H.E.R. for DreamWorks Animation’s “Forgotten Island,” has received two nominations at the 2026 Hollywood Music in Media Awards (HMMA). The track is nominated for Song – Animated Film and Music Video, according to the awarding body’s official list of nominees for its 17th edition. In the Song – Animated Film category, “BRB” will compete against “Bottle Up” from “PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie,” performed by the Backstreet Boys; “I Knew It, I Knew You” from “Toy Story 5,” performed by Taylor Swift; “Someone to Hold” from “Steps,” performed by BLACKPINK member […]...
